faqs.question: Why should we use your services?
faqs.answer: Cavora brings together handpicked destinations, transparent pricing, and round-the-clock human support so you can travel with confidence. Every itinerary is curated by people who have actually been there.

faqs.question: How do we help you with your services?
faqs.answer: From the first search to the moment you return home, our team assists with planning, booking, changes, and on-trip questions — all in one place.

faqs.question: Is there customer support available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our support team is available around the clock by chat and email, and premium bookings include a dedicated travel concierge.

faqs.question: How can I update my account information?
faqs.answer: Head to your profile settings, where you can update your personal details, payment methods, and travel preferences at any time.

faqs.question: How does Cavora handle payments?
faqs.answer: We accept all major cards and popular digital wallets through an encrypted, PCI-compliant gateway, so your payment details are never stored on our servers.

faqs.question: How do I get my invoice?
faqs.answer: A detailed invoice is emailed to you automatically after every booking, and you can download it again anytime from the Bookings section of your account.

faqs.question: Are there opportunities for discounts or promotions?
faqs.answer: Seasonal promotions, early-bird fares, and loyalty rewards run throughout the year. Subscribe to our newsletter to be the first to hear about them.

faqs.question: Are the prices listed always final?
faqs.answer: The price you see includes all mandatory fees and taxes. Any optional add-ons are shown clearly before you confirm, so there are no surprises at checkout.

faqs.question: What is the refund procedure?
faqs.answer: Refunds follow each booking's cancellation policy, shown before you pay. Eligible refunds are processed back to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

faqs.question: Is there browser or payment support available?
faqs.answer: Yes — Cavora works on all modern browsers, and if a payment fails our support team can help you complete it or suggest an alternative method.

faqs.question: What security measures does Cavora use?
faqs.answer: We protect your data with secure authentication and continuous monitoring, and we never share your information with third parties without consent.

faqs.question: How do I log in to this system?
faqs.answer: Log in with your email and password. Your authenticated Cavora session is stored securely in an HTTP-only browser cookie.

faqs.question: Are there any safety features in your system?
faqs.answer: Every partner is vetted, bookings are verified, and travel information keeps you informed about your destination before and during your trip.

faqs.question: How can I request more features?
faqs.answer: We love feedback. Send feature requests through the contact form or your account dashboard, and our product team reviews every suggestion.

faqs.question: Can I change my travel destination?
faqs.answer: In most cases yes — destinations and dates can be changed subject to the operator's policy. Manage changes from your bookings page or contact support.

faqs.question: How do I report an issue during my trip?
faqs.answer: If something goes wrong during your trip, use the contact form and a support agent will assist you as soon as possible.
